purpose: Teach: 杉山/土井/松尾/大石/杉浦/小坂/田原/赤松

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「杉山おじさんは古い友達」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was telling me that Uncle Sugiyama is an old friend of his.
lines.style: Warm, sharing-a-detail tone. Gentle cadence, like passing along a small piece of information about your husband to your son. Slightly nostalgic warmth on 'old friend.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと土井先生の料理番組観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a cooking show with Chef Doi.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick tempo on the opening. Genuine pleasure — the kind of small-victory tone a six-year-old gets when he's done something with Dad. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「松尾芭蕉の俳句を一緒に読もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad mentioned wanting to read some Matsuo Basho haiku together with you.
lines.style: Contemplative, slightly wistful. Speaking thoughtfully as if reflecting on what your husband finds meaningful. Steady, measured pacing. A mother noticing what her husband values.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと大石内蔵助の歴史番組観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a history program about Oishi Kuranosuke with Dad.
lines.style: Still pleased, but with a note of concentration — he's remembering the details, proud of what he watched. Slightly more focused than before. Genuine engagement, not just enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「杉浦おじさんは絵が上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying Uncle Sugiura is quite talented at drawing.
lines.style: Gentle observation, as if she's thinking aloud about the people in their lives. Warm tone but distant — not excited, just noting something true. Slight trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと小坂明子さんの懐メロ聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to some of Kosaka Akiko's old nostalgic songs.
lines.style: Genuine delight, with a soft quality — he's sharing in something Dad enjoys, and it makes him happy. Warm, connected tone. Not loud, but filled with simple joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが田原俊彦のアイドル時代を語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was telling me all about Tahara Toshihiko's time as an idol.
lines.style: Amused affection underneath. A mother slightly charmed by her husband's unexpected enthusiasm for an old idol. Gentle, conversational pacing with a hint of warmth in the observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「赤松おじさんに敬意を持って」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said I should treat Uncle Akamatsu with respect.
lines.style: Earnest and attentive. The tone of a six-year-old taking seriously what his father told him. Not uncertain — he's confident in this instruction. Small, steady voice with sincerity underneath.
